description.en: What joined the engine from the design specimen, each in its zone.
description.zh: 从设计样本并入引擎的东西，各在各的区域。

description.en: Figure, world and text, as the engine draws them.
description.zh: 图、物、文，引擎画出来的样子。

text.en: Nobody draws the tangent here. The [secant](noun:value) through $P$ and a second point $Q$ is drawn again and again as $Q$ comes in, each one left behind in transparent ink. Where they all agree the ink is deepest, and that is the tangent; then it turns from a guess (dashed, hollow) into a fact (solid).
text.zh: 这里没有人画切线。过 $P$ 和另一点 $Q$ 的[割线](noun:value)随着 $Q$ 靠近一遍遍画出来，每一条都用透明墨水留在纸上。它们都同意的地方墨最深，那就是切线；最后它从猜测（虚线、空心）变成事实（实线）。

caption.en: First your guess: tilt the hollow line through $P$ and let go. Then the secants come in as $h$ is halved, on the [curve](noun:function) $f$.
caption.zh: 先猜：转动过 $P$ 的空心直线，松手。然后 $h$ 不断减半，割线一条条进来，落在[曲线](noun:function) $f$ 上。

text.en: Here $f(x) = 0.15x^3 - 0.9x + 0.6$ and $x_0 = -2$. The same slope worked out by hand, with $f'$ in the colour of the slope, in the formula as in the figure:
text.zh: 这里 $f(x) = 0.15x^3 - 0.9x + 0.6$，$x_0 = -2$。同一个斜率用手算出来，$f'$ 用的是斜率的颜色，公式里和图里一样：

text.en: Try another function: the same picture works for any curve smooth at $P$.
text.zh: 换一个函数：只要曲线在 $P$ 处光滑，同样的画面都成立。

text.en: First a guess, before any explanation: where will this ball land? The hollow ring on the ground is your guess; letting go of it throws the ball, and the distance between your guess and the landing is drawn.
text.zh: 先猜，再听解释：这个球会落在哪里？地上的空心圆环就是你的猜测；松手就把球抛出去，你的猜测和实际落点之间差多远会画出来。

caption.en: A guess is hollow until the world answers it.
caption.zh: 猜测在世界给出答案之前，都是空心的。

text.en: A thrown [ball](noun:ball) leaves its past on the paper: where it was every tenth of a second, and the next third of a second dashed, as a guess. Look at the spacing before any number. Across, the ghosts are evenly spaced; up, they close together toward the top and open out on the way down.
text.zh: 抛出去的[球](noun:ball)把它的过去留在纸上：每 0.1 秒所在的位置，以及接下来 0.35 秒的虚线，那是一个猜测。先别看数字，看间距。横着看，影子间隔均匀；竖着看，越接近顶点挤得越紧，下落时又拉开。

caption.en: The last tenth of a second as its two legs: [across](noun:horizontal) never changes, [up](noun:vertical) shrinks to nothing at the top (ticked), then turns downward. Drag the arrow and let go to throw again.
caption.zh: 最近 0.1 秒拆成两段：[横向](noun:horizontal)始终不变，[竖直](noun:vertical)在顶点（刻线处）缩成零，然后转为向下。拖动箭头再松手，可以重新抛。

text.en: Nothing pushes the ball sideways, so it keeps its horizontal speed; gravity takes the same amount off its vertical speed every tenth of a second. The parabola is just these two facts drawn together.
text.zh: 没有东西横着推球，所以水平速度保持不变；重力每 0.1 秒从竖直速度里减去同样多。抛物线不过是把这两件事画在一起。

title.en: Text: what a sentence can hold
title.zh: 文 · 一句话里能装下什么

text.en: The [derivative](def: the limit of the slopes of the secants as $h \to 0$, when that limit exists; then $f$ is [differentiable](def: having a derivative there) at $x_0$) of $f$ at $x_0$ is the [slope](noun:value) the secants close onto[^cauchy]. In symbols it is the limit of one fraction:
text.zh: $f$ 在 $x_0$ 处的[导数](def: 当 $h \to 0$ 时割线斜率的极限（如果这个极限存在）；这时称 $f$ 在 $x_0$ [可导](def: 在那里导数存在))就是割线最后合拢到的那个[斜率](noun:value)[^cauchy]。写成符号，就是一个分式的极限：

says.en: the height at the second point
how far apart the two points are

text.en: Take $f(x) = x^2$ at $x_0 = 1$. With the second point {{h = 1, 0.1..2, 0.1}} to the right, the secant rises {{= (1+h)^2 - 1, 2}} over that run: its slope is {{= ((1+h)^2 - 1)/h, 2}}. The closer the points, the closer that is to 2.

A matrix moves the plane. With $a$ = {{a = 1.5, -3..3, 0.1}}, $b$ = {{b = 1, -3..3, 0.1}}, $c$ = {{c = 0.5, -3..3, 0.1}} and $d$ = {{d = 2, -3..3, 0.1}}, the unit square becomes a [parallelogram](noun:determinant) whose area is $ad - bc$ = {{= a*d - b*c, 2}}. The numbers in the sentence and the numbers in the figure are the same numbers.
text.zh: 矩阵会移动整个平面。取 $a$ = {{a = 1.5, -3..3, 0.1}}，$b$ = {{b = 1, -3..3, 0.1}}，$c$ = {{c = 0.5, -3..3, 0.1}}，$d$ = {{d = 2, -3..3, 0.1}}，单位正方形变成一个[平行四边形](noun:determinant)，面积是 $ad - bc$ = {{= a*d - b*c, 2}}。句子里的数和图里的数是同一组数。

caption.zh: $A$ 的两列围成的[平行四边形](noun:determinant)。

claim.en: A function differentiable at $x_0$ is continuous there.
claim.zh: 在 $x_0$ 可导的函数，在那里一定连续。

text.en: $f(x_0+h) - f(x_0)$ is the quotient times $h$, and the product tends to $f'(x_0) \cdot 0 = 0$.
text.zh: $f(x_0+h) - f(x_0)$ 等于差商乘以 $h$，而这个乘积趋于 $f'(x_0) \cdot 0 = 0$。

text.en: A limit of a product is the product of the limits, when both exist.
text.zh: 两个极限都存在时，乘积的极限等于极限的乘积。
所以 $f(x_0+h) \to f(x_0)$：在 $x_0$ 处没有跳跃。
在 $x_0$ 连续说的正是这件事。

summary.en: The other way round is false

text.en: $|x|$ is continuous at 0 but has no derivative there: from the right the secants have slope 1, from the left −1.
text.zh: $|x|$ 在 0 处连续，却没有导数：从右边看割线斜率是 1，从左边看是 −1。

text.en: The two sides close onto different lines, so there is no one tangent.
text.zh: 两边合拢到不同的直线上，所以没有唯一的切线。

text.en: Cauchy, Cours d’analyse (1821): the derivative as the limit of a ratio of differences.
text.zh: 柯西《分析教程》（1821）：把导数定义为差之比的极限。
